pre_condition: path is a string representing a file system path, possibly containing backslash or forward slash directory separators and a file extension
post_condition: Returns a string where: any backslash (\\) characters in path are replaced with forward slashes (/); the literal prefix "fm_agent/logic_verification_results/" is removed from the beginning if present; the file extension (including the dot) is removed; and every remaining path separator (/) is replaced with the literal string "::" (double colon). If path does not begin with the expected prefix, the prefix removal step has no effect.
